messages:
Nina Patel: Hi all, I'm Nina and just finished onboarding paperwork. I see two "New Hire Orientation" events stacked at 09:00 (my calendar shows one as 09:00 GMT+1 and another as 09:00 ET). One invite has no meeting link and the other is missing the recording note. Which one should I attend? My calendar is set to Europe/London so times are confusing. @Jordan L any tips?

Jordan L: Welcome Nina! :tada: The 09:00 ET is the live global orientation (recorded). The 09:00 GMT+1-looking event is probably the auto-generated regional sync. If you're in London, join the one that corresponds to your team's recommended slot (PeopleOps usually suggests the global session). We'll sort out the invites.

PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: Global New Hire Orientation: 09:00 ET, Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.com/orientation/global-jan2026. Recording will be available afterwards. If your invite lacks conferencing info, check the PeopleOps calendar or ask here.

Nina Patel: Thanks. My invite literally shows "Add conferencing" where the Zoom link should be. Also Outlook displays both entries overlapping.

IT Support: Thanks for flagging. Looks like the invites were created by two different schedulers with different timezone metadata (organizer tz set to America/New_York vs Europe/London). Some clients create two instances for the same timeslot when timezone fields mismatch. We're going to normalize the event timezone fields and resend.

Ravi: I hit this too yesterday. Quick user-side fix on Outlook web: open the event -> Edit -> Timezone -> set the explicit timezone dropdown to the event zone (e.g., Eastern Time) and save. That collapses the duplicate.

Jordan L: Can IT Support resend the corrected invites to the "new-hires-jan2026" list and include a clear recording placeholder in the description like "Recording: https://confluence.redwood.com/onboarding/orientation-recordings/2026-01"? Also please include the Zoom passcode in the description to help clients that don't pick up conferenceData.

IT Support: Will do. Resending invites with conferenceData block and explicit timezone=America/New_York for global, Europe/London for regional. Also updating the ICS to include the Zoom join URL and passcode in the description field. Expect new invites in ~5 minutes. If you still see duplicates, please remove both events and re-add from the new invite.

Nina Patel: New invite arrived and I re-added it. Link and passcode visible, time shows 14:00 for me (which is correct). Thanks y'all!

Ravi: Confirmed fixed on my side too. Recording placeholder is visible. Appreciate the quick response.

PeopleOps Bot: Recording will be uploaded to Confluence under /onboarding/recordings within 60 minutes after the session. If you need a 1:1 catch-up, message PeopleOps or book via the "New Hire Catch-up" calendar event.
